reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A total of EUR 108 million senior secured corporate loan to Elektroprivreda Crne Gore AD Niksic ("EPCG"), the Montenegrin national power utility, and its subsidiaries Green Gvozd LLC and Green Gvozd Second Phase LLC, special purpose vehicles established for the purpose of the development, construction and commissioning of wind power plant located near village Gvozd, municipality of Niksic, Montenegro for a total combined installed capacity of 75 MW (the "Project"). The Project will be structured in two phases, respectively 55 MW (financed with EUR 82 million, of which EUR 57 million A-Loan provided by EBRD and an EUR 25 million B-Loan syndicated to NLB) and 20 MW (financed with EUR 26 million to be provided solely by EBRD). The Project will result in the addition of 75 MW renewable energy generation capacity to the country, rolled out in two phases of 55 MW and 20 MW, which is expected to produce at least 141 GWh of renewable energy per year for the initial stage, and over 186 GWh when the second phase is complete and the plant fully operational. The construction of new renewable energy generation capacity in Montenegro is fundamental to the country's plans regarding the diversification of electricity generation to substitute its legacy thermal coal assets, which currently provide almost half of Montenegro's domestic electricity generation.
